import re

files = []
for name in sorted(('order/README.md', 'delivery/README.md')):
    path = Path(name)
    original = path.read_bytes()
    mode = path.stat().st_mode
    lines = original.splitlines(keepends=True)
    headings = []
    counts = {}
    fence = None
    previous = None
    for number, raw in enumerate(lines, 1):
        line = raw.decode('utf-8').rstrip('\\r\\n')
        if fence:
            if re.fullmatch(r' {0,3}' + re.escape(fence[0]) + '{' + str(fence[1]) + r',}[ \\t]*', line):
                fence = None
            previous = None
            continue
        opening = re.match(r' {0,3}("'`{3,}|~{3,})(.*)$'"', line)
        if opening and (opening[1][0] "'!= '"'"'`'"' or '"'`'"' not in opening[2]):
            fence = (opening[1][0], len(opening[1]))
            previous = None
            continue
        if line.startswith('    ') or line.startswith('\\t'):
            previous = None
            continue
        atx = re.match(r' {0,3}(#{1,6})(?:[ \\t]+(.*)|"'$)'"', line)
        setext = re.fullmatch(r' {0,3}(=+|-+)[ \\t]*', line)
        if atx:
            title = (atx[2] or '').strip(' \\t')
            title = re.sub(r'(?:"'^|[ '"\\t]+)#+[ \\t]*"'$'"', '', title).strip(' \\t')
            level = len(atx[1])
            start = number
        elif setext and previous:
            title, start = previous
            level = 1 if setext[1][0] == '=' else 2
        else:
            previous = (line.strip(), number) if line.strip() and not re.match(r' {0,3}(?:>|[-+*][ \\t]|\\d+[.)][ \\t])', line) else None
            continue
        counts[title] = counts.get(title, 0) + 1
        headings.append(dict(title=title, level=level, start=start, end=len(lines), occurrence=counts[title]))
        previous = None
    for index, heading in enumerate(headings):
        for following in headings[index + 1:]:
            if following['level'] <= heading['level']:
                heading['end'] = following['start'] - 1
                break
    selected = [h for h in headings if h['title'] == 'Build'][1]
    section = b''.join(lines[selected['start'] - 1:selected['end']]).decode('utf-8')
    assert path.read_bytes() == original and path.stat().st_mode == mode
    files.append(dict(path=name, sha256=hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest(), headings=headings, section=dict(start=selected['start'], text=section)))
print(json.dumps(dict(files=files), ensure_ascii=False))
PY"
